evidence.proved: HTTPS downloads from data.commoncrawl.org need no account, so the free read path is anonymous
evidence.quote: There is no need to create an AWS account in order to access the data using this method.

evidence.proved: the CDXJ index is rate limited and blocks an IP address that sends too many requests, so request-rate binds
evidence.quote: Our CDX API endpoint is frequently abused and therefore heavily rate limited. If your client sends too many requests in a short period of time, your IP address may be temporarily blocked.
